scope.target: Official NUS undergraduate programme / major information
scope.default_target_reason: The earlier project specification used NUS as the default/sample university; the latest user prompt did not provide a different university URL.
not_in_scope: Non-undergraduate graduate programmes unless listed as a special/part-time undergraduate route

method.approach: Official website evidence-first manual/browser extraction into structured records.
method.local_fetch_limit: Some NUS pages returned Incapsula/WAF challenge to simple Python urllib/curl fetches; official content was therefore collected from accessible official pages via browser/search extraction and cross-checked against NUS Bulletin / OAM official pages.

oam.title: NUS Office of Admissions — Undergraduate Programmes
oam.evidence: Office of Admissions page lists undergraduate programme pathways and says NUS offers 60 majors, 54 second majors, and over 80 minors; A-Z includes Architecture, Business Administration, Computing, Dentistry, Engineering, Humanities & Sciences, Law, Medicine, Music, Nursing, Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Science, PPE and special programmes.
oam.retrieval_note: Local urllib fetch was blocked by NUS Incapsula/WAF, but the official page content was accessible through browser/search extraction.

bulletin_programmes.title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 — Programmes index
bulletin_programmes.evidence: The Bulletin programmes index lists NUS faculties/schools/colleges and special, multi-/cross-disciplinary and other academic programmes.

cde.title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 — College of Design and Engineering Undergraduate Education
cde.evidence: CDE Bachelor’s Degree Programmes list includes Architecture, Industrial Design, multiple Engineering majors, Robotics and Machine Intelligence, and Landscape Architecture; degree requirements for cohorts 2025/26 onwards describe a 160-unit curriculum.

computing.title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 — School of Computing Undergraduate Education
computing.evidence: School of Computing degrees offered include Bachelor of Computing in Computer Science, Information Security, Business Artificial Intelligence Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Bachelor of Science in Business Analytics, and jointly Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering; programmes are four-year undergraduate programmes.

business.title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 — School of Business Undergraduate Education
business.evidence: NUS Business School offers BBA (Hons), BBA Accountancy (Hons), and BBA Real Estate (Hons); the BBA curriculum lists 9 majors including Accountancy, Applied Business Analytics, Business Economics, Finance, Innovation and Entrepreneurship, Leadership and Human Capital Management, Marketing, Operations and Supply Chain Management, and Real Estate.

science.title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 — Faculty of Science Undergraduate Education
science.evidence: Faculty of Science lists BSc (Hons) majors including Chemistry, Data Science and Analytics, Food Science and Technology, Life Sciences, Mathematics, Pharmaceutical Science, Physics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Data Science and Economics, plus Bachelor of Pharmacy / Bachelor of Pharmacy (Honours) and Bachelor of Environmental Studies (Honours).

fass.title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 — Faculty of Arts & Social Sciences Undergraduate Education
fass.evidence: FASS undergraduate degrees lead to Bachelor of Arts with Honours or Bachelor of Social Sciences with Honours; department degree requirements list 21 subjects including CNM, Economics, English, Geography, Global Studies, History, Philosophy, Political Science, Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Theatre and Performance Studies and Anthropology.

chs.title: NUS College of Humanities and Sciences — Programmes
chs.evidence: CHS page lists cross-disciplinary programmes (PPE, Data Science and Economics, Environmental Studies, Geospatial Intelligence) and primary majors; CHS students can read a four-year honours degree leading to BA, BSocSci or BSc.

law.title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 — Faculty of Law Undergraduate Education
law.evidence: The Law Bulletin states that the four-year LLB programme is available full-time and leads to the LLB (Hons) degree; the LLB is a professional degree recognised for admission to practice in Singapore.

medicine.title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 — Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine Undergraduate Education
medicine.evidence: Medicine offers two full-time undergraduate programmes leading to MBBS and BSc Nursing / BSc Nursing (Honours); it also describes BSc Nursing Practice and a career conversion programme for registered nurses.

dentistry.title: NUS Dentistry — Prospective Students / Undergraduate
dentistry.evidence: NUS Dentistry states the four-year full-time Bachelor of Dental Surgery comprises pre-clinical and clinical phases.

dentistry_education.title: NUS Dentistry — Education
dentistry_education.evidence: NUS Dentistry education page describes a comprehensive four-year Bachelor of Dental Surgery programme recognised by the Singapore Dental Council.

music.title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 — Yong Siew Toh Conservatory of Music Undergraduate Education
music.evidence: YST offers the Bachelor of Music (Honours), a four-year full-time undergraduate programme built around one of 20 music majors; students must complete 160 units.

scale.title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 — School of Continuing & Lifelong Education Undergraduate Education
scale.evidence: SCALE offers BTech Engineering programmes in Chemical, Civil, Electronics, Industrial & Management, Mechanical, and Supply Chain Management, plus Bachelor of Information Technology; BTech is typically completed by working adults on a flexible modular schedule.

warnings.message: Simple local HTTP fetches to several NUS hosts returned Incapsula/WAF/noindex challenge pages; source content in this dataset is official but was gathered using browser/search extraction rather than the existing urllib-only MVP crawler.

NUS OAM admissions choices sometimes group multiple majors under one choice, e.g. Engineering and Humanities & Sciences; this dataset includes both OAM choices and detailed Bulletin/college major records, so some concepts intentionally appear in both grouped and detailed form.
This output is programme information only and does not estimate admission chances or make admissions decisions.
